simple.summary: אֲדָמִי (ʼĂdâmîy) means Adami , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 33.

definitions.full: H129. Adami Hanneqeb הַנֶּ֫קֶב אֲדָמִי proper name, of a location pass in Naphtali , Josh 19:33 see נקב . II. אדם (, tawny , Ethiopic (only in derivatives), Assyrian adâmu ? Dl W ; compare Lag BN 28 ).
